<cite ref="Pesachim 113a">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> top (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6).—Part. <cite ref="D00022"><he>דָּאִיר</he></cite>, <he>דָּיֵיר</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 57:5">Targ. Ps. LVII, 5</cite> <he>דָיְירָא</he> Ms. (ed. <he>חיירא</he>).—
<cite ref="Yevamot 52a">Yeb. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>דאיר בבי וכ׳</he> he resides with his father-in-law.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 117a:6">B. Mets. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>דהוו דָיְירֵי</he> who occupied.
<cite ref="Taanit 24a:15">Taan. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>דָּיִירְנָא וכ׳</he> I live in a poor village.

senses.gloss: to go around, to peddle (cmp. h. סָחַר).
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 9b:8">R. Hash. 9ᵇ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="D01075"><he>דְּרוֹר</he></cite>, <cite ref="Leviticus 25:10">Lev. XXV, 10</cite>) <he>כמְדַיֵּיר דיירא ומוביל וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בי דיירא</he>, Ar. s. v. <he>דר</he> 3: <he>כי מדַוַּאר דריא</he>) as a traveller is licensed to go around and carry his goods through the whole district.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 113b:19">B. Kam. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>הני דדַיְּירֵי דירי</he> Rashi (ed. <cite ref="D01080"><he>דרי</he></cite>, Ms. R. <he>דמְדַיְּירֵי דיירי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) those (gentiles) who manure fields for pay by letting cattle live on them in folds.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 81a:10">Kidd. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ גולפי</he> placed jugs around (as a partition).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:16">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>רהוט … ולא דַּוְּורוּהוּ וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="M00973"><he>מטו</he></cite>, <cite ref="A02010"><he>אמטו</he></cite>) runners run but overtake not one who has taken a morning meal.
